name: Sticky Webbing

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters

disable: DC 15 Survival check or DC 15 Thievery check to carefully remove the strands.

items.name: Capturing Strands
items.text:
Trigger A creature that isn't a spider moves into the sticky webbing

---
Effect The sticky webbing covers the triggering creature's body. The triggering creature must succeed at a DC 19 Reflex save save or is Clumsy 1 until a 2 maneuver is performed to clean off the sticky webbing.

text: Fine, sticky threads of spiders' silk are strung across their lair.
